title: Agentic AI Security Skills SKILL.md Frontmatter
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for SKILL.md frontmatter. The Markdown body remains the place for detailed outputs, evidence, remediation, and references, while this schema validates the metadata agents and CI need for discovery.

name.description: Kebab-case skill identifier. Must match the skill directory name.

description.description: Agent-facing summary of what the skill does and when it should be invoked.

tags.description: Discovery tags covering domain, activity, technology, or role context.

role.description: Role bundles that should include or invoke this skill.

phase.description: Lifecycle phases where the skill applies.

frameworks.description: Frameworks, standards, taxonomies, or benchmark versions cited. Control IDs in findings must resolve to these references.

time_estimate.description: Expected time to run the skill for a typical target.

version.description: Semantic version for the skill contract and content.

author.description: GitHub handle, organization, or maintainer identity.

allowed-tools.description: Tool names the skill may use.

injection-hardened.description: True only after the skill has been reviewed against OWASP LLM01:2025 prompt-injection guidance.

disable-model-invocation.description: Optional role-bundle guard for workflows that should not directly invoke a model.
